# Autotape

Autotape is a retro-futurist theme aiming at the look of a vintage terminal without feeling dated. It is written for dark mode and recorded as compatible with light mode as well, and it follows the accent colour chosen in Obsidian. Typefaces are not bundled: the recorded description expects the user to bring their own for the intended effect.

![Autotape screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1612elphi/autotape-theme/HEAD/Screen.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Autotape"
    author: "1612elphi"
    repo:   "1612elphi/autotape-theme"
    slug:   "autotape"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/autotape"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/1612elphi/autotape-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1612elphi/autotape-theme/HEAD/Screen.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a glowing retro‑futurist terminal-inspired theme that delivers a minimalist, vintage terminal look without feeling dated. Use in Dark Mode (compatible with light), switch Obsidian accent colours, and bring custom typefaces for an authentic retro feel."
}
```
